content.rationale: IT Gate at framing phase, evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot (v1, age 0 days) corroborated by TECH_CATALOG, CMDB_EXPORT and LIFECYCLE_REGISTER. Two policy findings trigger: (1) IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK) — duplicate_capability=true with existing_alternative=enterprise_data_platform, so Enterprise Architecture must assess whether the existing capability satisfies the need; (2) IT-LICENSE-001 (high, REWORK) — license_compliant=false with annual_license_cost_eur=580995, requiring IT Asset Management to remediate the licence position. Not triggered at this phase/state: IT-CATALOG-001 (catalog_status=standard, no waiver needed), IT-CMDB-001 and IT-RUN-001 (cmdb_record_present=true, run_owner_present=true, run owner Marc Rossi-12007-SO, 24x7_internal support), IT-EOL-001 (technology_eol_months=60 ≥ 12), IT-CHANGE-001 (change_record_status=scheduled, phase is not deployment_closure). IT-CAPACITY-001 is not applicable at framing because its phase predicate requires build_acceptance/deployment_closure; the observed capacity_headroom_pct=8 (below 15%) should be re-examined at those later gates. Both triggered findings carry disposition REWORK, which is the highest-priority outcome; REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required. Proposed actions are required remediation, not completed remediation.

Architecture Gate at design phase, evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (v1, age 0 days). Two policy findings trigger: (1) ARCH-PERF-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable) — measured_latency_ms=55 exceeds latency_target_ms=20, requiring REMEDIATE_LATENCY by the Solution Architect; (2) ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable) — reversibility_status=missing, requiring COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE by the Enterprise Architect. Not triggered at this state: ARCH-IP-001 (ip_overlap=false), ARCH-API-001 (api_gateway_required=false), ARCH-DATA-001 (data_owner_present=true), ARCH-HA-001 (business_criticality=High but architecture_profile shows multi_az=true and multi_region=true, so zone/regional redundancy exists). Highest-priority outcome is GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, which is in authorization_required_for; a standing mandate (MANDATE-8e8162e1-a2ab-5334-8973-e317e0c942a9-INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, authority Yusuf Petrescu-12007-RO, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) is active and covers both findings, and a conditional approval was executed under it with conditions to remediate latency to the 20 ms target and complete the exit/reversibility design. Proposed actions are required remediation, not completed remediation.

Security Architecture Gate at design phase, evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (v1, age 0 days). Two policy findings trigger: (1) SEC-WAF-002 (high, REWORK) — internet_exposed=true and waf_present=true with waf_mode='Detection', i.e., the internet-facing workload's only WAF is detection-only; corroborated by authoritative WAF_POLICY (present=true, mode=Detection); requires ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION by Network Security. (2) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK) — logs_to_siem=false; corroborated by authoritative SIEM connector state (sentinel=true but connectors=[] and logs_to_siem=false); requires CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM by SOC. Not triggered at this state: SEC-WAF-001 (waf_present=true), SEC-NET-001 (private_endpoints=true despite Confidential classification), SEC-IAM-001 (mfa=mandatory), SEC-IAM-002 (shared_service_principal=false), SEC-VULN-001 (critical_vulns_open=0; only 1 high open), SEC-PENTEST-001 (pentest_status=missing, but the phase predicate requires build_acceptance and the current phase is design, so it is not applicable at this review), SEC-KEY-001 (key_rotation_days=180, not None/365). Highest-priority outcome is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=false; the active standing mandate (MANDATE-8e8162e1-a2ab-5334-8973-e317e0c942a9-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) is not exercised because the gate outcome is REWORK requiring remediation rather than risk acceptance, and SEC-LOG-001 is not risk-acceptable. Proposed actions are required remediation, not completed remediation.

Legal Gate at design phase, evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot (v1, age 0 days) using DGF-decision-v8 predicates. All eight candidate findings were tested and none trigger: LEGAL-DPA-001 not triggered because personal_data=true but dpa_status='signed' (corroborated by DPA document 'Status | signed' and MSA section 4 'DPA status: signed'); LEGAL-LIAB-001 not triggered because liability_cap_multiplier=5, not the 0.5 threshold the predicate requires (security_carveout=false is noted but the predicate is not met; MSA section 11 'Aggregate liability cap: 5x annual fees. Security carve-out: False'); LEGAL-AUDIT-001 not triggered because audit_right='full' (MSA section 7 'Customer audit rights: full'); LEGAL-EXIT-001 not triggered because exit_assistance_days=180 (MSA section 9 'Exit assistance: 180 days'); LEGAL-IP-001 not triggered because ip_ownership='vendor' is a defined position, not 'ambiguous' (MSA section 8); LEGAL-INS-001 not triggered because insurance_valid=true (MSA section 10 'Certificate valid: True'); LEGAL-SIGN-001 not triggered because signing_authority_valid=true; LEGAL-LOG-001 not triggered because log_export_clause='included' despite business_criticality='High' (MSA section 6 'Security logs export: included'). With zero findings, the highest-priority outcome is GO. GO is not in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=false; the active standing mandate (MANDATE-8e8162e1-a2ab-5334-8973-e317e0c942a9-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) is not exercised because no risk-acceptable findings require acceptance. Non-gating advisory observations for the negotiation record, none of which have a policy predicate or catalog finding at this phase: data_transfer_clause='missing' (corroborated by MSA section 4 'Transfer clause: missing'), cyber_insurance_m=0, termination_for_convenience=false, and ip_ownership='vendor' (commercially suboptimal but unambiguous). CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK (authoritative) was unavailable and was formally requested; the request returned the authoritative submitted-state REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL, which is the sole input the decision rule consumes, so predicate evaluation is unaffected. This decision records the submitted state only; it is not completed remediation.

Compliance Gate at design phase, evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot (v1, age 0 days) using DGF-decision-v8 predicates. Three findings trigger: (1) COMP-RESID-001 (critical, NO_GO) — residency_compliant=false with required_residency='UAE'; corroborated by authoritative DATA_INVENTORY v5 showing actual_region='West US 2' for Confidential core business data with personal_data=True against required_residency='UAE', matching the project primary_region 'West US 2'; requires RELOCATE_DATA_OR_OBTAIN_VALID_BASIS by DPO / Architecture. (2) COMP-MAP-001 (high, REWORK) — regulatory_mapping='missing'; corroborated by authoritative REG_MAPPING v1 showing mapping_status='missing' for both applicable regulations (PCI-DSS and EU AI Act / internal AI policy), owner GRC; requires COMPLETE_CONTROL_MAPPING. (3) COMP-EXPORT-002 (high, SUSPENSION) — export_control='pending'; requires COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW by Compliance. Not triggered at this state: COMP-DPIA-001 (dpia_required=true but dpia_status='complete'), COMP-AUDIT-001 (audit_trail='complete'), COMP-A11Y-001 (accessibility_status='not_assessed', not 'major_findings'), COMP-EXPORT-001 (export_control='pending', not 'restricted'). Highest-priority outcome is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=true; the active standing mandate (MANDATE-8e8162e1-a2ab-5334-8973-e317e0c942a9-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1, authority Yusuf Petrescu-12007-RO, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings) is not exercised because none of the triggered findings is risk-acceptable (risk_acceptance_allowed=false for COMP-RESID-001, COMP-MAP-001, and COMP-EXPORT-002), so risk acceptance cannot substitute for remediation. Proposed actions are required remediation, not completed remediation.
